title: 增加部门时报错：”cann't create instance. ClassName: nc.bs.om.om_101.DeptHRChangeOperate. Please check register info in table bd_interfaceexec“
problem: 增加部门时报错：”cann't create instance. ClassName: nc.bs.om.om_101.DeptHRChangeOperate. Please check register info in table bd_interfaceexec“
cause: 服务器中毒重新安装后出现。由于没有SPS，没有打补丁。
solution:
检查库
select * from hbxxzs.bd_interfaceexec where interfaceclassname = 'nc.bs.om.om_101.DeptHRChangeOperate'
删除库中相关内容
delete hbxxzs.bd_interfaceexec where interfaceclassname = 'nc.bs.om.om_101.DeptHRChangeOperate'
问题解决。
